name: NewsBench
description: NewsBench is a systematic evaluation framework and benchmark dataset designed to assess the editorial capabilities of large language models in Chinese journalism, focusing on writing proficiency and safety adherence across multiple editorial tasks and news domains.
reputation: A newer Chinese journalism benchmark that has seen some attention for evaluating editorial writing and safety, but is not yet a standard community benchmark.
notes: Uses GPT-4 based automatic evaluation protocols validated by human correlations; highlights strengths and weaknesses of LLMs in Chinese journalism.
